svg.text: Airline Ticketing System — Entity Relationship Diagram
PK = primary key · FK = foreign key · UK = unique · All timestamps are TIMESTAMPTZ in UTC
No seat rows are ever stored.
SOURCE OF TRUTH for what flies
CREATED LAZILY — only on first booking or hold.
Read paths never materialize a row.
first-booking races converge on one row.
A hold is a booking in HELD status,
not a separate entity — one lifecycle.
